pack.author: ai
pack.notes: Original creative direction; no external assets.

data.description: A patient, factual story told through real footage, archive pictures and a steady voice-over. The viewer should finish knowing one thing clearly, not ten things vaguely.

brief.mood: Thoughtful, honest and warm; curious rather than dramatic.
brief.pacing: Slow and even: shots of 4 to 7 seconds, cuts on the end of a spoken sentence, a 1 second breath after each chapter. Never cut faster than 2 seconds.
structure: Cold open: one striking image and one sentence that poses the question (0-10 s)
Title card on a quiet background
Three chapters, each opened by a short lower-third chapter title
Each chapter: establishing shot, detail shots, one fact on screen
Closing: return to the opening image, answer the question in one sentence
End card with credits and sources as on-screen text
doNot: No whooshes, flashes, glitches or zoom punches
No more than one on-screen text line at a time
No stock music with vocals under the voice-over
Never invent statistics; leave a [FACT?] placeholder text instead
brief.qualityBar: Every text on screen is readable for at least 3 seconds; the voice-over is never covered by music; every chapter answers part of the opening question.
